items.title: Eddie Metz Jr. interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, New York, October 3, 2015
items.q: And in front of me was Danny Turner and Bob Summers and all the way down to the front seat where Basie was.

ctx.x: When you first got on the Basie bus, was there a question like where do I go?

No. They said, “new boy, in the back.” That’s what they said. Sonny Cohn, “your seat’s in the back right in front of the toilet.” Okay. “Yes sir. No problem.” And then across the aisle was Cleveland Eaton because he’d take the bass and lay it on the back seat and then strap it in. So there was the big long back seat in the bus and the toilet. Cleveland was that seat and I was the one across from him. And in front of me was Danny Turner and Bob Summers and all the way down to the front seat where Basie was. And…
Did you have to play a different set of drums every night?
